notes.text: Hyman abbreviates both titles. Bekhorot gives Rav Chiyya bar Amram, as does [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1279&lang=en). Chagigah names Rabbi Yonatan ben Amram, also cited in [Heilprin’s Yonatan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1884&lang=en).
